title: Assisted Living Apartment Rate Card: Rent, Community Fee and Apartment Change Fee
content:
**Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement — apartment figures.** The published monthly rent of a newly contracted assisted living apartment depends on the apartment type, not on the care level; the same rent schedule, community fee and apartment change fee apply at every care level, Assisted Living Care Level 1 through Assisted Living Care Level 6.

### Published monthly rent by apartment type (USD per calendar month)

| Apartment type | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 | Level 5 | Level 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AL Studio | 4285.00 | 4285.00 | 4285.00 | 4285.00 | 4285.00 | 4285.00 |
| AL One-Bedroom | 5148.00 | 5148.00 | 5148.00 | 5148.00 | 5148.00 | 5148.00 |
| AL Companion Suite | 3162.00 | 3162.00 | 3162.00 | 3162.00 | 3162.00 | 3162.00 |

### One-time and per-move fees (USD)

| Item | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4 | Level 5 | Level 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Community fee, charged once at move-in, non-refundable | 4750.00 | 4750.00 | 4750.00 | 4750.00 | 4750.00 | 4750.00 |
| Community fee waived for a resident moving in directly from a Larkspur independent living residency | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Apartment change fee, per resident-requested move to another assisted living apartment | 650.00 | 650.00 | 650.00 | 650.00 | 650.00 | 650.00 |

### Notes to the rate card

- The published rent is the rent for a newly contracted apartment of that type; a residency's contracted monthly rent is the figure recorded on its own admission agreement or later rent change.
- The AL Companion Suite is a shared companion suite.
- Hypothetical comparison: a resident moving from an AL Studio to an AL One-Bedroom would move from a published rent of 4285.00 to 5148.00 per month; the apartment change fee is a separate one-time figure of 650.00.
